folds: 3 held TX pairs x3 held days, fit only other4TX and other2days
packets: Each70 L_s cell split into35+35 by existing source-relation-split-v1 physical-ID order
fit: For each directed source RX pair, both independent-half orientations: anchor A -> destination B minus anchor B; anchor B -> destination A minus anchor A. Only fit TX/day.
predictors: affine ridge, scalar centered-input RMS normalization, ridge=.1, output shrink=.4; no hyperparameter search
inputs: one held L_s anchor half A joint160 or state40; never other held RX or V features
outputs: star potentials for all5 source RX with anchor potential0; any pair is difference, cycle-consistent within a fixed anchor
scoring: held L_s halfB and independent V means; equal heldTX/day, equal five anchors and ten undirected pairs; same predictions for L_s_B/V
advancement: Every seed conditional_joint strictly improves both full and centered-logit V MSE vs shared_rx and zero, and margin V MSE vs shared_rx and zero; L_s_B full MSE also improves shared_rx. Only primary may advance; no alternative selection.
